metadata.timing_boundary: BVH build and synchronous TrueKNN query/refit measured inside Arkade; excludes file I/O, OptiX context/pipeline creation, voxelization, cropping and H2D
metadata.stability_note: Two Arkade subprocesses terminated with SIGSEGV during the formal run. The first required an atomic-checkpoint resume; the second succeeded on the first bounded retry. Failed attempts are excluded from timing samples.
